subject: Pricing breakdown: HSM seat amortization, audit-log tiers & residency options
messages:
From: Julian Park <julian.park@clearwell.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearwell.ai>
Date: 2027-05-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: line-item pricing & amortization for compliance add-ons

Hannah —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to get a clear line-item breakdown for the compliance add-ons so we can circulate a version to finance. Specific asks:

- HSM/KMS: can you provide both a per-seat list price and an option to amortize the seat cost over 12 / 18 months? We prefer amortization if it’s allowed.
- Audit logs: we need price per GB retained per month by retention tier (90d / 1yr / 3yr) and any discounts for pilot.
- Residency: cost delta for US-only vs multi-region EU+US (we may want EU later).
- Any one-time implementation fees (SOW) you anticipate for HIPAA onboarding.

We attached our SOW draft for context (high-level). Can you get me a breakdown this week? Also, do you support limited-time credits for pilots?

Appreciate it — Julian

Attachments: Clearwell_SOW_draft.pdf (stub)

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julian Park <julian.park@clearwell.ai>
Date: 2027-05-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: line-item pricing & amortization for compliance add-ons

Julian —

Thanks, got the SOW. I pulled together an initial pricing grid and a few packaging options; attaching the spreadsheet. Quick summary:

- HSM/KMS: list price $36k/seat/year. We can offer amortization as a contractual concession: finance will amortize over 12 or 18 months on the invoice (we typically subsidize shorter amortization via reduced credits).
- Audit logs: three tiers:
  * 90d retention — $0.035/GB/month
  * 1yr retention — $0.020/GB/month
  * 3yr retention — $0.012/GB/month (volume tiers apply)
- Residency: US-only delta is ~$0.08/token relative to multi-region due to cross-region infra and legal controls; we can model a blended price for a phased EU rollout.
- HIPAA onboarding: one-time implementation fee range $10k–$25k depending on environment (VPC, migrations, SOC evidence exports).

Pilot credits: we can extend a pilot credit against audit logs (up to 40% on the audit-log charges for the first 3 months) and up to 2 months free residency for initial proof-of-concept (subject to commitment).

I have ben and steph on a quick internal thread to confirm the concession approach; cc'ing them now. If this rough basket looks OK, I can produce a redlined term sheet + SOW for signature.

Attachment: compliance-pricing-grid.xlsx (stub)

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0193

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: line-item pricing & amortization for compliance add-ons

Ben / Steph —

Forwarding Clearwell's ask. They want an amortized option for HSM seats (prefers 12/18m), audit-log tier pricing with pilot credit, and residency delta. My initial grid (attached to the external reply) recommends:

Option A (Pilot-friendly):
- HSM: amortize 12m, apply 25% upfront credit on first invoice to soften cashflow impact
- Audit logs: 40% credit for first 3 months, then list price with volume tier
- Residency: 2-month free residency pilot, then apply US-only delta if they keep residency
- SOW fee: cap onboarding at $15k for standard VPC + attestation

Option B (Finance-friendly):
- HSM: amortize 18m, no upfront credit (blended invoice works better for ops)
- Audit logs: 30% credit first 2 months only
- Residency: no free months, discounted delta of 10% for first 6 months

Ask: which of these do we want to present? Ben — do you have a preference from a margin/ risk perspective? Steph — if we do amortize on the contract, finance requires the deal_id and contract term to be locked to avoid revenue leakage; confirm whether legal needs any extra wording for the amortization schedule.

Thanks — Hannah

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-28T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: line-item pricing & amortization for compliance add-ons

Quick take — favor presenting Option B but with one hybrid concession:

- Approve HSM amortization over 18 months (finance prefers longer amortization).
- Provide a 30% audit-log credit for first 3 months (stretch the timeline a bit to win pilot).
- Offer 1 month free residency pilot rather than 2 months; tie any additional free period to a 12-month minimum commitment post-pilot.
- Cap onboarding SOW at $12k if they choose standard VPC (anything above to be scoped into a separate professional services SOW).

Steph — if you confirm legal language can bind amortization to the contract term and remove options to terminate without settlement, I’m good to present this. Hannah — present as "Pilot concession package (finance-approved)" and I'll back the deal.

Ben
VP, Commercial Operations
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Julian Park <julian.park@clearwell.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@clearwell.ai>
Date: 2027-05-29T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing breakdown: HSM seat amortization, audit-log tiers & residency options

Hannah / team —

Thanks for the clear options and quick internal run. Clearwell is happy to proceed on the hybrid you outlined: amortized HSM over 18 months, 30% audit-log credit for the first 3 months, and a single month residency pilot (we'll commit to 12 months if we convert). Please send a redline and updated term sheet / SOW and we'll aim to sign by next week.

One quick ask: can you include an onboarding checklist in the SOW (contacts, expected lead times for KMS setup, and SOC2 evidence export windows)? That will help our internal security team.

If you send the updated package, I can have procurement route for signature.

Thanks — Julian
Clearwell Health
julian.park@clearwell.ai
